events.quote: Zelensky says Ukraine not yet received official security guarantees equivalent to NATO article 5
events.detail: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to Article 5 of NATO, which provides for a collective response to aggression.

events.quote: Ukraine, UK agree to jointly produce Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain
events.detail: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting have signed project agreements on the joint production of Ukrainian middle-strike and deep-strike drones.

events.quote: Ukrainian forces strike bridge, ammunition depot and Russian command posts
events.detail: On November 20 and overnight into November 21, Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck a bridge, an ammunition depot and command posts of the Russian military.

events.quote: Explosions reported near Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast amid drone alerts
events.detail: Ukrainian monitoring channel WarTranslated, citing Russian accounts, reported claims that drones were attacking the Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk.

events.quote: Zelensky says Putin must understand Crimean Bridge 'will not stay,' warns Russia increasing double-tap strikes
events.detail: President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is increasing its double-tap strikes and even conducting triple-tap strikes to "kill as many people as possible" in its attacks.

events.quote: DM Khmara says Russia will need several months to raise damaged section of Kerch Bridge
events.detail: Minister of Defense of Ukraine Yevhenii Khmara said Russia would need several months to raise the damaged section of the Kerch Bridge.

events.quote: Zelensky: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before Ukraine struck Kerch Bridge
events.detail: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had carried out 109 attacks on Ukrainian bridges before Ukraine launched a retaliatory operation against the Kerch Bridge.

events.quote: Strikes on Kerch Bridge can force Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations – Ukraine at OSCE
events.detail: The consequences of Russia's rejection of Ukraine's proposals for a ceasefire are now visible on the Kerch Bridge.
